messages.subject: marginal effects
parts:
Dear all,

I would like to calculate marginal effects (see https://stats.stackexchange.com/tags/marginal-effect/info) or here (https://strengejacke.github.io/ggeffects/index.html). 
Basically, I am interested in how the prediction changes when I vary the value of a predictor variable (potentially facetted by the levels of other predictors). 

What is the best way to do this in INLA ? 

Thanks,
Martin

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] marginal effects
parts:
Hi,

I would have approached this using simulation from the fitted model,
like in the attached example.

You can also approach the linear predictor from 'Predictor', and then
subtract the terms you do not want, instead of building it up from
scratch.

There might also be something in the thread:

Re: [r-inla] Calculate 95% CI around computed value using output,
additive interaction

in the r-inla-discussion-group, that can be relevant.

Let me know if its still unclear.

H
